newsitem.title: USA: News Corp in Japanese record deal.
newsitem.headline: News Corp in Japanese record deal.

text.p: News Corp Ltd has created a joint venture company with Japanese recording artist and producer Tetsuya Komuro, a spokeswoman for News Corp said.
A source close to the deal said the new company will be a music and multimedia company, which will be launched in Asia and will eventually expand worldwide.

News Corp said Lachlan Murdoch, managing director of News Ltd and deputy chairman of Star TV, both subsidiaries of media mogul Rupert Murdoch's News Corp, and Tetsuya Komuro will announce the venture on Friday in Los Angeles.
A source said it is believed that Star TV, a satellite television company based in Hong Kong, will serve as a distribution mechanism in the venture.
